qa_pair.question: Using list_publication_facets, find how many AMIRA publications are in French, then use search_publications to count the French journal articles. Return the two counts as integers separated by a comma and a space.
How many publications in the bibliography carry no language metadata at all? Use the language facet's missing count, not a single search page. Return an integer.
Look up the repository identifiers epub-9405 and eref-95983 separately with get_publication. They are the same record; return its amira_url without Markdown formatting.
Compare the collection overview's count of publications with extracted full text with search_publications filtered by has_fulltext=true. Return the count once both agree.
Publication 29949 is a thesis. Return the AMIRA authority URL of its thesis adviser as given in the publication detail, without constructing a URL from the adviser's name.
How many research items come from Côte d'Ivoire? Use the country filter. Return an integer.
Count the research items from Niger and, separately, from Nigeria, using the country filter for each. Return the two integers separated by a comma and a space, Niger first.
How many research items have digitised media files attached? Return an integer.
Which model generated the transcripts of the AMIRA podcast episodes, and for how many episodes? Return the model name and the episode count separated by a comma and a space.
Among the subjects used by research items, how many are Library of Congress Subject Headings and how many are free tags? Return the two integers separated by a comma and a space, LCSH first.
What is the GND identifier recorded for the person Drescher, Martina? Return the identifier only.
Which institution does the acronym UJKZ denote? Return its amira_url without Markdown formatting.
Research item 10185 is held by an institution recorded as its provenance. Return that institution's amira_url without Markdown formatting.
Research item 10185 carries the identifier 30625. What type of identifier is it, as recorded in the catalogue? Return the type exactly.
qa_pair.answer: Publisher, distributor, or vendor stock number
